name: It
source:
"...I'm not good with that sort of 'love'. I don't understand it."

The protagonist of this story.
He has already died and arrived at "The End"; in order to get out, he must play a game against Faceless.
Yet, he cannot seem to recall how he died.

Uninterested in others, he is apathetic and composed. He is an honest man but not a caring person. Generally calm and strong-willed.
